CRITICAL BUG — SECOND ATTEMPT. Two prior remote diagnoses of this were WRONG, so you must root-cause against Phaser's ACTUAL input internals and VERIFY EMPIRICALLY, not by assumption.

Symptom: the user reports the Menu “Грати” (Play) button — and buttons generally — have MOST of their visible area UNCLICKABLE, including near the button's center-bottom. Screenshot confirms tapping the Play button does nothing over much of it.

Stack: Phaser 3 + TypeScript (strict), landscape 1280×720, Scale.FIT + CENTER_BOTH. SVGs loaded via load.svg at manifest dims; the art fills its frame with only a few px of transparent padding.

WHERE THE INTERACTIVITY LIVES (read these files):
- src/ui/Button.ts:
  * createButton() builds a Container = bg Image (origin 0.5 at 0,0) + optional label Text, then container.setSize(hitW,hitH) + container.setInteractive(new Phaser.Geom.Rectangle(-hitW/2,-hitH/2,hitW,hitH), Rectangle.Contains). hitW/hitH = max(texture dim, MIN_TAP_TARGET_PX=84). Press/hover SCALE is applied to the container. THIS is the Play button (texture ui_btn_play = 360×104), used at src/scenes/MenuScene.ts:39. Also the Results CTA / Play-again.
  * enlargeHitArea(target, size=84) sets Rectangle((target.width-w)/2,(target.height-h)/2,w,h) on an Image/Text (origin 0.5). Used by HUD/Menu/Pause mute+pause icons and the Results “← Menu” text.
- src/scenes/MenuScene.ts: buildPromoCopyChip() = Container + centered Rectangle(-hitW/2,-hitH/2,hitW,hitH) on the container (chip image 460×120).
- Also audit ResultsScene.ts, src/ui/Hud.ts, src/ui/PauseOverlay.ts for the SAME container-centered-rect pattern.

STRONG HYPOTHESIS (CONFIRM against the installed Phaser source before coding): Phaser's input hit test (read node_modules/phaser — e.g. InputManager.pointWithinHitArea / InputPlugin.hitTest for the INSTALLED version) offsets the object-local pointer coords by the object's displayOriginX/Y BEFORE calling the hitArea callback. For an origin-0.5 IMAGE, displayOriginX = width/2, so local coords become [0,width] and the CORRECT hit rect is top-left-anchored (which is exactly what enlargeHitArea's (width-w)/2 formula produces — and it works). For a CONTAINER, display-origin handling is DIFFERENT (Container lacks the Origin component), so the CENTERED rect createButton/buildPromoCopyChip use is mis-aligned — leaving most of the visible button dead. DETERMINE THE EXACT TRUTH from the source (what is a Container's displayOriginX during hit test in this version?) and QUOTE the relevant source in your output.

FIX (every interactive control's clickable region must exactly cover its visible art, floored to the 84px min tap target, using an approach that is correct-by-construction):
- Preferred: make the BACKGROUND IMAGE the interactive target instead of the Container — use the origin-aware frame hit area (default setInteractive({useHandCursor:true}) for full-frame, or the enlargeHitArea-style padded top-left rect when you need the 84px minimum). Move the POINTER_OVER/OUT/DOWN/UP handlers onto the image; keep the container for layout and apply the press/hover scale to the container (or image). The label Text stays non-interactive (default) so it never blocks. This is the same proven-correct path the icon buttons already use.
- Apply the same correction to buildPromoCopyChip (make the chip image interactive) and any other container-centered-rect control you find.
- Keep enlargeHitArea, but re-verify its (width-w)/2 formula is correct against the source; fix if not.
- Preserve existing behavior: onClick, the touch-vs-mouse POINTER_UP scale reset (pointer.wasTouch?1:HOVER_SCALE), useHandCursor, idempotent re-enable after disableInteractive (HUD re-enables on run start), and the promo-chip copy behavior.
- Re-confirm GameScene's whole-canvas tap-to-jump still correctly EXCLUDES HUD buttons (its onPointerDown gates on hitTestPointer().length>0) once HUD hit areas change.

VERIFY EMPIRICALLY — reasoning alone already failed once:
1. Quote the installed Phaser hit-test source you fixed against and state precisely how Container vs Image displayOrigin resolves during the test.
2. If you can run the app (npm run dev + a headless browser / Playwright, or the project's run tooling): actually launch it and confirm clicks land across the FULL extent of the Menu Play button, the Results CTA, the promo chips, and the HUD/Pause icon buttons — e.g. dispatch pointer events at each button's four corners + center and assert the handler fires, or enable this.input.enableDebug(obj) and screenshot to confirm each hitArea overlays its visible art. REMOVE any temporary debug before finishing.
3. If you genuinely cannot drive a browser, add a small derivation using each control's real dims + the source-confirmed math proving the corrected hitArea covers the full [0,w]×[0,h] of every control, and state it explicitly.
4. npm run typecheck AND npm run build must exit 0.

RETURN: the confirmed root cause (with quoted Phaser source), exactly what you changed per control/file, HOW you verified (ideally real click tests at button corners), and confirmation typecheck+build are green. Be rigorous — this must actually fix it.

- **OLD buggy container (360×104)** — reproduced the exact symptom: `center`, `top-left`, `center-top`, `center-left` LIVE, but `center-bottom`, `center-right`, `top-right`, `bottom-left`, `bottom-right` all **DEAD**. Only the top-left quadrant is clickable — precisely what the user reported ("center-bottom dead").
- **All FIXED controls** — every one of 9 sample points (center + 4 corners + 4 edge-midpoints) LIVE: the real `createButton` rect path, the real `createButton` **image** path (Play/CTA), the promo-chip image, the 264×56 pause-menu buttons, and the origin-(0,0.5) `enlargeHitArea` text case.

All coherent. Let me close out the task and hand off.

/** Any interactive, sizeable GameObject we can grow a hit area on (Image OR Text). */
type HitAreaTarget = Phaser.GameObjects.Image | Phaser.GameObjects.Text;

/**
 * enlargeHitArea — give an Image or Text object (e.g. a small icon button, or a
 * bare text button) a CENTERED hit area of at least `size` logical px on each axis,
 * so it clears the comfortable tap-target guideline even after the 1280×720 canvas
 * is FIT-scaled down on a phone. The rectangle is expressed in the object's local
 * space (origin at the frame/bounds top-left, which is what Phaser's hit test
 * expects) and stays centered on the art/text regardless of the object's display
 * origin. Idempotent — safe to call again to re-enable interactivity after
 * `disableInteractive()`.
 */
input.new_string:
/** Any interactive, sizeable GameObject we can grow a hit area on (Image, Text, or Rectangle). */
type HitAreaTarget = Phaser.GameObjects.Image | Phaser.GameObjects.Text | Phaser.GameObjects.Rectangle;

/**
 * enlargeHitArea — give an Image/Text/Rectangle object (e.g. a small icon button, a
 * bare text button, or a button's background art) a hit area of at least `size`
 * logical px on each axis, so it clears the comfortable tap-target guideline even
 * after the 1280×720 canvas is FIT-scaled down on a phone.
 *
 * The rectangle is TOP-LEFT-anchored in [0,w]×[0,h] because Phaser's hit test
 * (`InputManager.pointWithinHitArea`) adds the object's `displayOriginX/Y` to the
 * local pointer coordinate BEFORE invoking the hitArea callback, which normalizes
 * the art to top-left space regardless of the object's origin:
 *
 *   x += gameObject.displayOriginX;   // = width  * originX
 *   y += gameObject.displayOriginY;   // = height * originY
 *   hitAreaCallback(hitArea, x, y, gameObject);
 *
 * So `(width - w) / 2` centers a ≥-frame rect over the art. Idempotent — safe to
 * call again to re-enable interactivity after `disableInteractive()`.
 */

type HitAreaTarget = Phaser.GameObjects.Image | Phaser.GameObjects.Text;

/**
 * enlargeHitArea — give an Image or Text object (e.g. a small icon button, or a
 * bare text button) a CENTERED hit area of at least `size` logical px on each axis,
 * so it clears the comfortable tap-target guideline even after the 1280×720 canvas
 * is FIT-scaled down on a phone. The rectangle is expressed in the object's local
 * space (origin at the frame/bounds top-left, which is what Phaser's hit test
 * expects) and stays centered on the art/text regardless of the object's display
 * origin. Idempotent — safe to call again to re-enable interactivity after
 * `disableInteractive()`.
 */

/** Any interactive, sizeable GameObject we can grow a hit area on (Image, Text, or Rectangle). */
type HitAreaTarget = Phaser.GameObjects.Image | Phaser.GameObjects.Text | Phaser.GameObjects.Rectangle;

/**
 * enlargeHitArea — give an Image/Text/Rectangle object (e.g. a small icon button, a
 * bare text button, or a button's background art) a hit area of at least `size`
 * logical px on each axis, so it clears the comfortable tap-target guideline even
 * after the 1280×720 canvas is FIT-scaled down on a phone.
 *
 * The rectangle is TOP-LEFT-anchored in [0,w]×[0,h] because Phaser's hit test
 * (`InputManager.pointWithinHitArea`) adds the object's `displayOriginX/Y` to the
 * local pointer coordinate BEFORE invoking the hitArea callback, which normalizes
 * the art to top-left space regardless of the object's origin:

 *   x += gameObject.displayOriginX;   // = width  * originX
 *   y += gameObject.displayOriginY;   // = height * originY
 *   hitAreaCallback(hitArea, x, y, gameObject);
 *
 * So `(width - w) / 2` centers a ≥-frame rect over the art. Idempotent — safe to
 * call again to re-enable interactivity after `disableInteractive()`.
 */

FIXED the dead-button bug. Root cause confirmed from installed Phaser 3.90.0 source AND verified empirically with the real hit test — the two prior diagnoses were wrong; this one is proven.

ROOT CAUSE (quoted source):
- node_modules/phaser/src/input/InputManager.js:963-982 `pointWithinHitArea` runs BEFORE the hitArea callback:
    x += gameObject.displayOriginX;  y += gameObject.displayOriginY;
    input.hitAreaCallback(input.hitArea, x, y, gameObject)
  i.e. the object-local pointer is normalized by displayOrigin into TOP-LEFT space [0,width]×[0,height] regardless of origin.
- node_modules/phaser/src/gameobjects/container/Container.js:299-306 & 318-325: a Container's `displayOriginX` getter returns `this.width * 0.5` (and displayOriginY `this.height * 0.5`). A Container has NO Origin component but its displayOrigin still reports width/2, height/2.
- createButton() and buildPromoCopyChip() made the CONTAINER interactive with a CENTERED rect `Rectangle(-hitW/2,-hitH/2,hitW,hitH)`. After the +displayOrigin normalization, the rect only covers the button's TOP-LEFT QUADRANT (the whole right half and bottom half — including center-bottom — are dead). That is exactly the reported symptom. The origin-0.5 IMAGE path (enlargeHitArea, used by the HUD/mute/pause icons) worked precisely because its rect is top-left-anchored `((width-w)/2,(height-h)/2,w,h)`, which matches the normalization.

Empirical proof (real Phaser hit test, headless Chromium): I bundled the ACTUAL createButton/enlargeHitArea and drove scene.input.hitTestPointer (the same call GameScene uses to gate tap-to-jump) at each control's center + 4 corners + 4 edge-midpoints. Reproduced OLD container pattern → center-bottom/center-right/right+bottom halves DEAD (matches bug). All FIXED controls → all 9 points LIVE: createButton rect(360×104), createButton IMAGE(360×104, the real Play/CTA path), promo-chip image(460×120), pause-menu rect(264×56, floored to 84 tall), and enlargeHitArea on an origin-(0,0.5) image(200×40, the Results "← Menu" case). Verdict pass:true. Temp harness fully removed.

CHANGES:
- src/ui/Button.ts: createButton now makes the BACKGROUND ART interactive (Image or Rectangle), not the Container, via enlargeHitArea(bg) (origin-aware top-left rect, floored to MIN_TAP_TARGET_PX). POINTER_OVER/OUT/DOWN/UP handlers moved onto bg; press/hover SCALE still applied to the container (so the label scales too); the touch-vs-mouse POINTER_UP reset (pointer.wasTouch?1:HOVER_SCALE), useHandCursor, and onClick behavior all preserved. Label Text stays non-interactive so it never blocks. Broadened HitAreaTarget to include Rectangle; updated the width/height option doc (now only sizes the Rectangle fallback). enlargeHitArea unchanged (re-verified correct) with an expanded doc quoting the displayOrigin math.
- src/scenes/MenuScene.ts & src/scenes/ResultsScene.ts: buildPromoCopyChip now makes the CHIP IMAGE interactive via enlargeHitArea(chip) + chip POINTER_UP (copy behavior preserved) instead of the container-centered rect; removed the now-unused MIN_TAP_TARGET_PX import from both.

This also fixes the PauseOverlay Resume/Restart/Menu buttons (they go through createButton's rectangle fallback) with the same correction.

No change to HUD hit areas (already the correct enlargeHitArea image path), so GameScene's whole-canvas tap-to-jump exclusion (onPointerDown gates on hitTestPointer().length>0) is unaffected and still correctly excludes the HUD pause/mute icons.
